effortScale.title: Controlled Effort
effortScale.mechanic: You kept your cool. You narrate the outcome (Success or Failure) exactly how you want it. You look capable, or your failure is tragic and noble.

effortScale.title: Pushing It
effortScale.mechanic: You exerted yourself. You narrate the core outcome. The other players suggest 2-3 potential "costs" (scratches, noise, lost time). You choose one to include.

effortScale.title: Overexertion
effortScale.mechanic: You pushed too hard. Whether you Succeeded or Failed, the Sacrifice you agreed upon before rolling happens. If Success: You get what you wanted, but you pay the price. If Failure: You don't get what you wanted, and you still pay the price.

effortScale.title: Breaking Point
effortScale.mechanic: You lost control. The Agreed Sacrifice happens, AND it gets worse. The other players suggest "The Twist"—a new, horrible piece of information or immediate danger. You choose which Twist becomes true. (This counts as a Strike).

d13.title: The d13
d13.description: Roll a d10 (0-9) and a d4 (1-4). Add them together for a result between 1 and 13.
d13.note: d10 is the Main Die (0 reads as 0). d4 is the Effort Die. A modifier can never push a die outside its natural range (0-9 or 1-4).

gameLoop.description: Draw up to 2 Threat Cards (or the next Prologue Ace) and choose one. Frame the scene using the card's Suit & Rank prompt.

The Active Player directs the scene (with veto power), asks an Act-specific Focus the Camera question for others to answer, accepts one "Something's not right..." escalation, and agrees on the Overexertion Sacrifice.
Roll the d13 (d10 + d4). Apply Genre Point rerolls (+1 to d10) or Aptitude shifts (±1 to d4). Compare Total vs Difficulty and check the Effort Scale.
Narrate the outcome, award a Genre Point if earned, assign any Strikes, and update the physical decks.

strikes.title: Three Strikes
triggers: Fail any Test against a Face Card (the Killer).
Roll a 4 (Breaking Point) on the Effort Scale (Success or Failure).
(Final Girl Rule module): Draw a Face Card onto the table.
strikes.consequence: On the 3rd Strike, the character dies and their Suit Aptitude is permanently lost. If all 4 characters die, the game is lost.

genrePoints.title: Genre Points
genrePoints.description: Start with 13 tokens on the table. Award 1 GP at the end of a scene for great horror tropes or roleplay. Spend 1 held GP to reroll the entire d13 and add +1 to the d10 Main Die (max 9). You must accept the new result, and the spent token is removed from the game.

threat.title: Threat Deck
threat.setup: Deal 8 random Number Cards (2-10) face down, add 1 Jack, and shuffle. Place the 4 Aces face up on top.
threat.mechanic: Resolve the 4 Aces (Establishing Shots) one at a time, then keep 2 cards drawn face up on the table (cannot draw while a Face Card is visible).

reserves.title: Reserves
piles: Number Reserve: Deal 14 remaining Number Cards face down (1 starts the Trophy Pile, leaving 13 in Reserve; unused Number Cards are removed)
Face Card Reserves: Remaining Jacks (3), Queens (4), and Kings (4) in separate piles
Jokers: Red & Black Jokers kept separate for The Finale

trophy.title: Trophy Pile
trophy.setup: Flip the top card from the Number Reserve face up.
trophy.mechanic: Top card sets Base Difficulty for Face Cards (+1 J, +2 Q, +3 K) and Jokers (+0). Number Cards use their own Rank.

aces.title: Aces (Prologue — Establishing Shots)
aces.description: Difficulty is Rank 1 (impossible to fail) and uses the matching character's Aptitude (worst Effort is Overexertion). Once completed, remove the Ace from the game as that player's Suit/Aptitude reminder token (do not add to Trophy Pile or draw from Reserve).

numberCards.title: Number Cards (2-10)
numberCards.success: Move Threat Card to the top of the Trophy Pile (new Base Difficulty). Add the next Number Reserve card to the bottom of the Threat Deck.
numberCards.failure: Place Threat Card at the bottom of the Threat Deck. Add the next Number Reserve card to the bottom of the Threat Deck.

faceCards.title: Face Cards (The Killer)
faceCards.success: First time defeating a Suit removes the Face Card (Weakness Found); otherwise it returns to the Threat Deck. Killer Retaliates based on Effort (d4): 1-2 adds a Jack, 3-4 adds a Queen (fallback: Jack -> Queen -> King). Shuffle Threat Deck & Trophy Pile.
faceCards.failure: Gain 1 Strike. Return the Face Card to the Threat Deck and add a King from the Reserve. Shuffle Threat Deck & Trophy Pile. (Resolving the first Face Card, Win or Lose, starts Act 2).

endgame.title: The Three Acts & The Finale

acts.title: Act 1: The Setup
acts.description: Play the 4 Prologue Aces, then standard scenes. Ends as soon as the first Face Card confrontation is resolved (Win or Lose).

acts.title: Act 2: The Horror Story
acts.description: The Killer is actively hunting. Defeat Face Cards of all 4 suits to uncover the Killer's 4 Weaknesses.

acts.title: Act 3: The Climax
acts.description: Triggers when 4 Weaknesses are found OR 13 cards have been added from the Number Reserve. Remove all Number Cards from the Threat Deck.

acts.title: The Finale: The Jokers
acts.description: Triggers when all 4 Weaknesses are found. Shuffle both the Red and Black Jokers into the remaining Face Cards.

endgame.trigger: Act 3 triggers when 4 Weaknesses are found OR 13 Reserve cards are added. The Finale triggers when all 4 Weaknesses are found.
endgame.setup: On Act 3, remove all Number Cards from the Threat Deck. On The Finale, shuffle in both Jokers.

redJoker.title: Red Joker (The End)
redJoker.effect: The Final Test. Shuffle Trophy Pile; Difficulty = Top of Trophy Pile (+0). No Aptitude edge.
redJoker.failure: Active Character is killed. Shuffle the Red Joker back into the Threat Deck and shuffle the Trophy Pile.

blackJoker.title: Black Joker (The Twist)
blackJoker.effect: One last desperate attempt. Shuffle Trophy Pile; Difficulty = Top of Trophy Pile (+0). No Aptitude edge.
blackJoker.success: Remove the Black Joker from the game and remove the highest Face Card from the Threat Deck. Shuffle Threat Deck & Trophy Pile.
blackJoker.failure: Remove the Black Joker from the game and add a King to the Threat Deck. Shuffle Threat Deck & Trophy Pile.

modules.name: Classic Setup
modules.description: Curated deck setup: Threat Deck uses 2s, 3s, 4s + 1 Jack (with 4 Aces on top); Number Reserve stacks 5s through 10s in order; Trophy Pile starts with a random 10.

modules.name: Final Girl Rule
modules.description: Drawing a Face Card immediately inflicts 1 Strike, and Act 3 + The Finale (Jokers) begin immediately when only 1 surviving character remains.

creationSteps: Come up with a clear Archetype.
Think of a reason "Why are you here?".
Select an Aptitude (each of the 4 characters claims one Suit: Power, Resolve, Intellect, or Finesse).

aptitudes.description: Your Aptitude represents your character's natural strengths. When facing a Threat Card matching a living character's Aptitude Suit, you can modify the Effort Die (d4) by +1 or -1. Increase (+1) to push for Success (higher Total) at greater risk. Decrease (-1) to play it safe (lower Effort) but risk Failure (lower Total). If a character dies (3 Strikes), their Suit's Aptitude is permanently lost. No one gets an Aptitude edge against a Joker.
